title: DeploymentOpsContract
description: Machine-readable deployment entrypoint contract: OpenTofu owns the Cloudflare edge, the cluster fleet is provisioned declaratively by Cluster API + Talos installation media + per-cell Argo CD, production worker zero-touch is gated by the node config-serving plane, the root Makefile owns operator entry, day-2 changes route through ops, and no manual SSH troubleshooting.

_meta.amendment_note: v2.0.0 (ADR-0375): retire the OCI/on-prem OpenTofu+shell deployment model. OpenTofu now owns only the Cloudflare edge; cluster lifecycle moves to Cluster API + Talos (installation media) + Argo CD. The infra/oci + infra/onprem trees and their shell-consolidation inventory are removed.
source_directives: no handrolling; declarative IaC and a minimal, intuitive bootstrap/Makefile.
once setup, everything managed through ops/GitOps.
no manual ssh command troubleshooting. just works out of the box.
everything from control plane to worker auto-installs from installation media; cluster lifecycle via CAPI, apps via Argo CD.

deployment_authority.rationale: OpenTofu declarative state owns the Cloudflare edge (tunnel, DNS, Zero Trust Access). The Talos cluster fleet is provisioned by Cluster API (declared in git, reconciled by controllers) — see cluster_fleet below; it is not a tofu root.

roots.state_policy: root-declared backend; tunnel, DNS, and Zero Trust Access are OpenTofu-managed

cluster_fleet.model: Cluster API + Talos + Argo CD (ADR-0375; supersedes ADR-0120/0121)
cluster_fleet.node_install: Talos installation-media (infra/talos/installation-media): control-plane config is baked offline; node media is generic/no-secret and becomes production zero-touch only when node_config_serving_plane has evidence for MAC/UUID -> machineconfig assignment. Until then, node media is experimental for more than hand-assigned nodes.
cluster_fleet.cluster_lifecycle: CAPI (infra/capi): clusterctl init + Talos/OCI/AWS/Metal3 providers; spoke Cluster CRs in infra/capi/clusters/
cluster_fleet.bootstrap_addons: CAPI ClusterResourceSet installs Cilium + Argo CD per cluster (infra/capi/crs)

node_config_serving_plane.readiness_claim_boundary: `gen-media.sh node` only builds a generic no-secret Talos image with `talos.config=$CONFIG_URL`. It does not prove production worker zero-touch until a hub-side config-serving plane or adopted Talos/Sidero metadata server maps attested machine identity to a generated Talos machineconfig and records custody/audit evidence.

serving_endpoint.contract: CONFIG_URL terminates on a private hub endpoint that returns exactly one Talos machineconfig for the requesting node when, and only when, the request can be bound to an approved assignment registry row.
serving_endpoint.fallback_policy: No generic worker machineconfig fallback is allowed; unknown or ambiguous machines fail closed.

trusted_binding_sources: adopted Talos/Sidero metadata identity with operator-approved registry row
assignment_identity.forbidden_binding: Do not trust a self-asserted MAC/UUID parameter by itself for production config release.

machineconfig_custody.raw_config_storage: Generated Talos machineconfig is stored only in an approved secret/custody system (for example OpenBao or sealed off-host envelope); the repo and registry store refs and SHA-256 digests only.
custody_invariants: No machineconfig, bootstrap secret, token, or certificate material is committed to git.
Every generated config has a digest, version, owner, and audit-chain event before it can be served.
Config reads are audited without logging secret payloads.

authn_authz.network_boundary: Private bootstrap network or equivalent protected ingress; endpoint is not a public unauthenticated internet URL.
authn_authz.write_authorization: Assignment registry writes require ops-platform approval and policy/audit evidence.
authn_authz.read_authorization: Config reads require an attested machine identity match plus active assignment status; mismatches return no secret-bearing body.

rotation_revocation: Revoking an assignment prevents any future config serve for that MAC/UUID and records revoked_at plus audit_chain_event_id.
Machineconfig rotation creates a new version/digest and keeps prior versions non-servable unless explicitly rollback-approved.
Lost or reassigned hardware requires assignment revocation, Talos credential/certificate rotation as applicable, and CAPI reconciliation through the normal fleet path.
bootstrap_failure_behavior: Unknown, duplicate, expired, or revoked identities fail closed with 403/404 and no machineconfig payload.
The operator-facing failure record names the assignment reason and remediation path, but never exposes machineconfig secrets.
Failure does not fall back to SSH troubleshooting; remediation is an assignment registry or generated-config fix followed by normal Talos/CAPI retry.
node_config_serving_plane.architecture_boundary: Preserves ADR-0375: CAPI/Talos/Argo CD owns the fleet; OpenTofu remains Cloudflare edge only.
safe_local_validation: Fixture assignment registry rows can validate MAC/UUID uniqueness, required fields, revocation, and digest shape without live hardware.
Fixture machineconfig files can validate digest/custody refs without containing real secrets.
`gen-media.sh node --dry-run` remains a no-network command-shape check and does not claim a serving plane exists.

makefile.command_policy: Make targets may invoke cargo/Rust gates and tofu only (Cloudflare edge). They must not embed ssh troubleshooting, oci compute mutation, or terraform CLI. Cluster-fleet bring-up is git/CAPI-driven (see `make fleet`). `make fleet-preflight` is non-mutating readiness evidence only and must not run clusterctl init, kubectl apply, tofu apply, Talos media builds, or hardware boot steps.

bootstrap_contract.goal: Cold-start the deployment toolchain without bespoke runbooks.
minimum_behaviour: validate this deployment contract with Rust
verify tofu is installed and point to official OpenTofu install docs if absent
avoid networked package installation except OpenTofu/provider downloads requested by tofu init
non_goals: run component shell install scripts directly

install_contract.scope_note: `make install` provisions ONLY the OpenTofu-owned Cloudflare edge (it is `install: apply`). It does NOT provision the cluster fleet — fleet bring-up is hardware-gated (boot Talos installation-media on real nodes) and multi-step, and `make fleet` is informational-only (prints the sequence). Treat fleet bring-up as a separate, manual/hardware-gated procedure; `make fleet-preflight` is the safe cloud-ci/readiness pipeline entrypoint until a hub kubeconfig exists for live bootstrap evidence (registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml#adr-0375-fleet-bootstrap-pipeline).
normal_flow: run tofu apply for infra/cloudflare (this is the entire `make install`)
fleet_bring_up_separate: build Talos installation-media (infra/talos/installation-media/gen-media.sh) and boot it on the control-plane + node hardware
clusterctl init onto the formed control plane (infra/capi/init.sh)
add cells to infra/capi/clusters/values.yaml and helm template | kubectl apply — CAPI reconciles; per-cell Argo CD then owns app delivery
install_contract.confirmation_policy: OpenTofu apply prompts by default; do not use hidden auto-approve in the Makefile.

covers: Talos installation-media control-plane and node command shapes
Cluster API provider pins and clusterctl init command shape
spoke-cell Helm render shape for infra/capi/clusters
per-cell Argo CD app-of-apps Helm render shape for infra/gitops
hardware-gated cut lines that keep live bootstrap separate from Cloudflare edge install
forbidden_during_preflight: hardware boot or cluster state mutation
expected_artifacts: crs/crs-configmaps.yaml when Helm and kubectl are available
crs/clusterresourceset.yaml when Helm and kubectl are available
future_live_bootstrap_evidence_once_hub_: Talos control-plane ISO checksum and custody/shred evidence, not the ISO itself
node Image Factory schematic id and checksum
CRS apply audit-chain row against the hub
per-cell Argo CD sync health transcript

ops_management_contract.rule: After bootstrap/install, desired-state changes, drift repair, status, and incident workflows are initiated through ops, Argo CD, or repo-native Rust controllers, not ad hoc SSH sessions.
incident_flow: route fix through CI/CD hotfix PR, OpenTofu desired-state change, or Argo CD git change
do not page a human and do not manually SSH-troubleshoot

preconditions: active production safety incident where OpenTofu/CAPI/ops is unavailable
audit-chain row emitted before or immediately after action
follow-up PR restores declarative desired state
break_glass.normal_runbook: not present; break-glass is not a troubleshooting recipe

acceptance_criteria.rule: root Makefile exists and exposes all required targets
OpenTofu is the only deploy mutation authority for the Cloudflare edge; the cluster fleet is CAPI/Talos/Argo CD declared in git
manual SSH troubleshooting and OCI CLI mutation are explicitly forbidden
the deployment durable goal no longer routes incidents to page-on-call

worker-node production zero-touch is not claimed until node_config_serving_plane is implemented with assignment-registry, machineconfig-custody, authn/authz, revocation, and fail-closed bootstrap evidence
